title: Monsoon Holiday Notice
body: Due to heavy rainfall forecasted this week, the school will remain closed on Friday, Aug 7. Regular classes resume Monday.

title: Term 3 Fee Due Reminder
body: Term 3 tuition fees are due by Aug 10, 2026. Please clear pending dues via the Fees section to avoid late charges.

title: Annual Sports Day - Save the Date
body: Our Annual Sports Day will be held on Aug 22, 2026 at the school ground. All parents are invited to attend and cheer!

title: New Library Corner Opened
body: We are excited to announce a new reading corner in the Sunshine Room, stocked with age-appropriate picture books.
